subject: Change font family of pdf files generated in Shiny

messages.author: b0b3bf1e1e469492
messages.subject: Change font family of pdf files generated in Shiny
parts:
Hi all, I would like to allow users of my Shiny app to download a pdf of a generated plot with a specific font family (for example, Helvetica Neue).

When I do this on my local machine, I install the extrafont package, load my desired fonts from their corresponding font files on my harddrive, then use the pdf function with my desired font in the family argument.

However, when I try to replicate this in a Shiny app, I receive an error saying that the font family is not found.

Here is a simple example (that currently does not work...)

## ui.R

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("font.family", "Choose Font", 
                  choices = c("Helvetica Neue", "Times New Roman", "Arial")
      ),
      downloadButton("downloadPlot", "Download Plot as PDF")
    ),
    
    # Show a plot of the plot
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("distPlot", width = "800px", height = "800px")
    )
  )
))


## server.R


library(extrafont)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
  
plot(1, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))
text(.5, .5, "TEXT HERE", cex = 10)
  
})

output$downloadPlot <- downloadHandler(
  
  filename = function() {paste('VisualResume.pdf')}, 
  content = function(file){
    
    font.family <- input$font.family
    
    pdf(file, width = 11, height= 8.5, family = font.family)
    
    plot(1, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))
    text(.5, .5, "TEXT HERE", cex = 10)
    
    
    dev.off()
  },
  contentType = "image/pdf"
)


})
